_meta.scenario: Driver no-show — assigned driver did not arrive at the pickup location without valid reason. Admin cancels the trip and a full refund of the advance payment is triggered for the customer since Cabbo is at fault.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = true → full refund triggered. Driver availability is freed.

reason: Assigned driver did not reach pickup location. Trip cancelled on behalf of customer.

cancelation_detail.reason: Driver was unreachable and did not show up at the scheduled pickup time. Customer was waiting.
